findings.message: The precondition authenticates warehouse_operator, but the supplied requirement authorizes only sales_manager; the successful-approval oracle is unsupported for this role and requires an explicit product-defined authorization scenario or outcome.
evidence: TC-AUTH-001.expected_outcome=HTTP 200 is returned with status APPROVED.
REQ-AUTH-001.text=Only sales_manager may approve an order through POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/approve; a successful approval returns HTTP 200 with status APPROVED.
